sgl_addressHelp: As written in your source - the notation is detected or chosen on the right
sgl_alreadyKnown: This register already exists: "%s" (column %s, %s). Activate it in the catalog instead of creating it twice.
sgl_ambiguous: %s can be a Sungrow document number (counts from 1) or a protocol address (counts from 0). Where does the number come from?
sgl_ariaInstructions: Press space to pick up the register, move it with the arrow keys and press space again to drop it into a group. Escape cancels.
sgl_badAddress: This address is not valid for the chosen notation.
sgl_busLoadDetail: %s of %s requests/s · %s requests per round set · %s registers
sgl_busLoadMarks: 80 % fully used · 100 % limit measured on the reference installation
sgl_busLoadModel: Calculated from the real block building of the adapter. Capacity: about 1.25 requests/s through the WiNet-S2 (measured: live 5 s + energie 60 s + steuerung 60 s + akku 120 s ran stable at ~95 %; live 3 s skipped rounds; akku 60 s caused timeouts). Pauses of slow devices (battery unit 2: 5 s) block the bus on top.
sgl_checkUnit2: Also look for a Sungrow battery (SBH) at unit 2 (takes up to 15 s)
sgl_confirmWrite: %s will be set to %s. The adapter writes it, reads it back and logs the result.
sgl_dataTypeHelp: Sungrow: U16 = uint16be, S16 = int16be, U32/S32 = uint32sw/int32sw (low word first)
sgl_deviceIdHelp: 1 = inverter, 2 = SBH battery (as set in the WiNet)
sgl_diagHint: Today values reset at midnight, values in brackets since the counters were created. "Skipped" = the previous round of the group was still running: the interval is too short for the bus.
sgl_displayNameHelp: Name of the object - can be changed any time
sgl_dropHere: Drag registers here or use "+" in the catalog
sgl_editHint: Address, unit and name build the state ID of "%s" and cannot be changed here.
sgl_factorHelp: Value = raw value × factor + offset (e.g. 0.1 for 0.1 V)
sgl_groupDesc_akku: SBH battery (unit 2) - 5 s instruction interval in the WiNet
sgl_groupDesc_info: Device information and rarely changing settings
sgl_groupsHint: Each group has its own interval. Registers close to each other are read in one request.
sgl_hostHelp: In the WiNet web interface the address of this ioBroker must be in the Modbus whitelist
sgl_houseUnbalancedHint: unknown source? (e.g. a generator the inverter does not measure)
sgl_measuredNote: The groups show the round duration measured by the running instance.
sgl_nameIdHelp: Becomes part of the ID, e.g. 13023_Battery_level
sgl_notAlive: The instance is not running - live values and test reads need a running instance (save and start it).
sgl_notAnsweredHelp: A %s behind a WiNet-S2 answered this address with "illegal data address". If you activate it, the whole request of its group fails - only use it on other models.
sgl_notMeasuredNote: Start the instance to see the measured round duration per group.
sgl_notation_protocol: protocol address (from 0: Excel lists, Home Assistant, evcc)
sgl_nothingReleased: No register is released for writing - the adapter writes nothing to the inverter.
sgl_offByOne: Careful with counting from 0 or from 1 - one register next to it is:
sgl_orphans: %s active register(s) are in a group that does not exist (%s) and are not read.
sgl_poolHint: %s registers. Activate with "+" (group of the button, arrow = other group) or drag the handle into a group.
sgl_previewFree: Costs no additional request in "%s" - lies next to registers already read.
sgl_profileDesc_akku: Basic plus battery power, level and energy counters (via the inverter).
sgl_profileDesc_basis: PV power and yield, grid import/export, inverter state.
sgl_profileDesc_erweitert: Everything known: phases, MPPT details, device data, SBH battery modules (unit 2).
sgl_readOnlyActive: Read only is on: every write command is rejected and the device value restored.
sgl_readOnlyHelp: Master switch: when on, nothing is written to the inverter - no matter what is released below.
sgl_reasonGap: +1 request because %s is not next to the others (%s registers after %s, at most %s are bridged)
sgl_reasonSize: +1 request because the block up to %s would be longer than %s registers
sgl_reasonType: +1 request because holding registers (FC3) are read separately from input registers (FC4)
sgl_reasonUnit: +1 request because unit %s is another device
sgl_regTypeHelp: A 6-digit Modicon number brings its own type
sgl_testReadHelp: Reads the register once over the running connection (read only, FC3/FC4).
sgl_tileMissing: The register for this tile is not read yet.
sgl_tilesHint: Order the tiles by dragging the handle or with the arrows; "Save" keeps the layout. House = inverter AC output + grid import (− feed-in).
sgl_warn_roundTooLong: The measured round (%s ms) is longer than the interval.
sgl_warn_skipRisk: Can skip rounds: group "%s" pauses %s ms after each request.
sgl_warn_skipSure: Skips rounds: shorter than the pause of group "%s" (%s ms).
sgl_warn_timeoutShort: Timeout %s ms should be longer than the pause.
sgl_wizardConflict: Instance %s is active and talks to the same gateway. The WiNet-S2 serves only one Modbus client reliably - deactivate it first.
sgl_wizardIntro: Three steps: gateway address, connection test, choice of registers. Nothing is written to the inverter.
sgl_wizardNoBattery: No battery at the inverter detected.
sgl_wizardNoUnit2: No SBH battery answers at unit 2.
sgl_wizardNotAlive: The connection test needs the running instance. A new instance starts by itself; otherwise start it in the instance list.
sgl_wizardOverwrite: The wizard replaces the selection of registers by a profile. Own registers stay.
sgl_wizardSaveHint: Then click "Save" - the instance restarts with the new settings.
sgl_wizardUntested: Not tested - the profile is suggested without device data.
sgl_wizardWhitelist: ECONNRESET usually means: the address of this ioBroker is missing in the Modbus whitelist of the WiNet-S2.
sgl_writableHint: Writing is released per register. A register that is not released rejects write commands (logged below). The value range is checked before writing.
sgl_writeCheckHelp: Range = min/max or the value table of the register.
sgl_writeCheck_warn: write and warn in the log
sgl_writeSent: command sent - waiting for the confirmation
